claim: Stacked on MAIL-MESSAGE-ID-ONE-SHAPE (2026-11-11): the orchestrator applies the same '<id>' rule (services/agent-orchestrator/services/rfc822_message_id.py): the email parser stores the canonical id and its In-Reply-To/References lookup matches message_id in both '<id>' and 'id' shapes; the composer's threading reads stored ids canonical. Migration 20270625100000 (public.mail_message_ids_canonicalise, service role only) rewrites existing channel='email' rows only (never WhatsApp's wamid), is idempotent, leaves a row whose rewrite would break uniq_proc_conv_sent_message_id (first in-scope row per order and id wins) and a value that would outgrow varchar(500). Proven by tests/test_rfc822_message_id.py and supabase/tests/20270625100000_mail_message_id_one_shape_test.sql.
